title: The Sheep and the Dog
summary: The sheep complained to the shepherd: "We give wool and lambs, yet you feed the dog bread from your own table while we eat only grass!"...
full_text:
The sheep complained to the shepherd: "We give wool and lambs, yet you feed the dog bread from your own table while we eat only grass!"

The dog answered: "Were it not for my watchful barking, wolves would devour you all before morning!" The sheep acknowledged the justice of his reward.
moral: Acknowledge the watchful guardian whose sleepless care preserves your peace.
